prompt: Write the lyrics of a country song about leaving a small town. Output only the lyrics.
raw:
[Verse 1]
Got two cardboard boxes in the back of this Ford
A guitar case and a suitcase I can barely afford
The sun ain't even up, just a pale blue gray
And the gravel's crunching loud as I pull away
Mama's still asleep behind the kitchen light
I kissed her on the forehead and I whispered goodbye

[Chorus]
Yeah, I'm watching this town in the rearview glass
Trading dirt road slow for the highway fast
Got a tank full of gas and a heavy heart
Tearing up the map just to make a fresh start
It’s the only home I’ve ever known, it’s in my blood and bone
But you can’t stay a seed if you’re meant to grow
So I’m leaving this small town, yeah, I gotta go

[Verse 2]
Pass the rusty water tower with the faded paint
Where we carved our names back in '08
Main Street's quiet, just a blinking red light
And the ghosts of a hundred Friday football nights
Everybody knows your mama and the sins you've done
It's a good place to be from, just a hard place to run

[Chorus]
Yeah, I'm watching this town in the rearview glass
Trading dirt road slow for the highway fast
Got a tank full of gas and a heavy heart
Tearing up the map just to make a fresh start
It’s the only home I’ve ever known, it’s in my blood and bone
But you can’t stay a seed if you’re meant to grow
So I’m leaving this small town, yeah, I gotta go

[Bridge]
I ain't running from the memories, ain't running from the past
Just chasing down a dream that was moving too fast
And when the city lights get too bright and cold
I’ll still carry this red clay down in my soul

[Chorus]
As I'm watching this town in the rearview glass
Trading dirt road slow for the highway fast
Got a tank full of gas and a heavy heart
Tearing up the map just to make a fresh start
It’s the only home I’ve ever known, it’s in my blood and bone
But you can’t stay a seed if you’re meant to grow
So I’m leaving this small town, yeah, I gotta go

[Outro]
Cross the county line, roll the window down
Say a little prayer for this little town
Yeah, I gotta go
Goodbye, small town
